problem: The caption says 'Notice the same three element types: inertia, spring and damper', but the Rotational branch of the tree shows only one node, 'Inertia J'. The figure does not show any rotational spring or damper, so the caption promises something the figure does not deliver.
fix: Either add 'Torsional spring kt' and 'Torsional damper b' nodes to the Rotational branch, or reword the caption to: 'The translational branch carries the values used in the worked example; the rotational branch shows the matching element, inertia J. Both sides have the same three element types: inertia, spring and damper.'

problem: 's² + 2ζωns + ωn²' runs the symbol ωn straight into s, so a reader on a phone can read it as ωns or as 2ζωns as one quantity.
fix: Write 's² + 2ζωn s + ωn²' with a space before s, and state 'ωn is the natural frequency in rad/s and ζ is the damping ratio (no unit)'.

problem: The answer gives F = c v, but the chapter itself defines the damper force as −c x′, opposing motion. A student may take F = c v as the signed force in the equation of motion.
fix: Answer: 'c relates the magnitude of damper force to speed: |F| = c v, where v is in m/s. With x positive to the right the force on the mass is −c x′. The SI unit is N·s/m.'
